```dart title="Dart"

import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;

    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<h1>One</h1>\n<!-- /// --->\n<p>Two</p>', options: options);

    RustLib.dispose();

}
```
